action.command:
cd /workspace
for s in fpp comment; do
  echo "=== start $s ==="
  curl -s -X POST -o /dev/null -w 'POST: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/process/start/$s
done
sleep 30
for port in 18007 18008; do
  /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import socket
s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1)
try: s.connect(('127.0.0.1',$port)); print('$port OPEN')
except Exception as e: print('$port CLOSED', e)
"
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "  /docs: %{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:$port/docs
done
